objective.text: Use backward-compatible expand-and-contract database changes during a rolling release.

difficulty.rationale: Keep old and new application versions compatible while a persisted representation changes.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: Old workers still read full_name while a new release will use display_name. The application must remain available during a gradual rollout.

stem: Which migration strategy supports that overlap safely?

options.text: Add the new column compatibly, backfill and transition readers/writers, then remove the old column after old code is retired.
options.rationale: An expand-and-contract transition provides a period in which both versions can operate, with removal deferred until the old dependency is gone.

options.text: Rename full_name immediately before updating the first application node.
options.rationale: Old nodes still using full_name would fail while the rollout is mixed.
options.misconception: Old nodes still using full_name would fail while the rollout is mixed.

options.text: Drop full_name and let each old worker recreate it on its next request.
options.rationale: That loses the shared schema contract and risks data loss and request-time migration races.
options.misconception: That loses the shared schema contract and risks data loss and request-time migration races.

options.text: Change the model accessor only and assume both database columns are created automatically.
options.rationale: An accessor does not create or backfill the required schema representation.
options.misconception: An accessor does not create or backfill the required schema representation.
